title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 045 ]

blocks.text: Since so many of our conversations are held on the telephone, telephone calls are situations worthy of special consideration. Good manners on the telephone, of course, are the same as good manners elsewhere. What is more important is thoughtfulness for others. But thoughtfulness for others in the use of telephone is based on one important point. Do not keep the telephone call to yourself. Remember that it is shared by several people who have an equal right to its use.

readingSentences.english: Since so many of our conversations are held on the telephone, telephone calls are situations worthy of special consideration.
readingSentences.korean: 그렇게 많은 우리 대화가 전화상에서 이루어지므로, 전화 호출은 특별한 고려의 가치가 있는 상황이다.

readingSentences.english: Good manners on the telephone, of course, are the same as good manners elsewhere.
readingSentences.korean: 물론 전화상의 좋은 예절은 다른 분야의 좋은 예절과 같다.

readingSentences.english: What is more important is thoughtfulness for others.
readingSentences.korean: 더 중요한 것은 다른 이를 위한 배려이다.

readingSentences.english: But thoughtfulness for others in the use of telephone is based on one important point.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 전화의 사용에서 다른이를 위한 배려는 한 가지 중요점에 근간을 둔다.

readingSentences.english: Do not keep the telephone call to yourself.
Remember that it is shared by several people who have an equal right to its use.
readingSentences.korean: 전화기는 사용자의 동등한 권리를 가진 수명의 사람들에 의해 공유된다는 것을 기억해라.
